claim: Etula, Rinne, Suominen, Vaittinen (RFS 2020, 33(1):75-111): institutions raise cash for month-end payments by selling equities until the settlement-implied deadline (T-4 under T+3, T = last trading day). US CRSP VW return 1995-2013: -17 bp over T-8..T-4 and +77 bp over T-3..T+3 (abnormal -37 / +48 bp); corr(T-3..T-1, T-8..T-4) = -0.54 in 2003-2013; 22 of 25 markets show significant reversals; the 2014 European T+3->T+2 change moved the reversal closer to month end (DiD -0.776, t -3.70).
quote: settlement rule is negative -17bp for T-8 to T-4 and positive 77bp for T-3 to T+3
limitations: Working-paper version dated 2017-12-28 (the RFS 2020 version is behind a paywall; the Aalto reprint returned 403). US evidence ends 2013, all under T+3; no trading-rule net returns for an index window.
independent_replication: Nathan, Suominen and Tasa (2026) extend the sample to 2025 and add the 2024 US T+1 reform (shares an author, Suominen). Quantseeker (practitioner, read via summarizer only) finds the [-3,+3] ETF window still significant after 2015 but declining, and [0,+3] insignificant.
impact_on_spec: Fixes the trade window: enter after the marginal cash-raising day b, exit after tau+3; motivates the conditional (negative pre-window) variant.

claim: Nathan, Suominen, Tasa, "The Intramonth Momentum Cycle" (2026-06-08 working paper): over 1980-2025 US momentum concentrates in PreTOM [tau-9, tau-4]; bottom-decile losers trail the market by 7.9 bp/day there (VW), about 70% of it reverses in Post [tau-3, tau+3]; the May 2024 T+1 reform moved the marginal cash-raising day from tau-4 to tau-3: D1 loser mean at tau-4 -6.9 -> +51.4 bp, at tau-3 -3.7 -> -31.4 bp, DiD +85.9 bp (t 2.68), loser-vs-winner triple difference +196 bp (t 2.20). Net of quoted spreads the PreTOM-only WML earns 14.9 bp/month (2001-2025).
quote: settlement transition shifts the selling pressure one day later, as predicted
limitations: Unrefereed working paper; post-reform sample 19 months (June 2024-2025), individual day effects not significant; the authors say the result describes when momentum is realized, not a within-month trading rule; cross-sectional evidence uses CRSP market caps and delisting returns that we lack.
independent_replication: None independent; builds on Etula et al. 2020 (shared author). Our 2026-01..09 months are outside its sample.
impact_on_spec: Sets b = tau-4 before 2024-05-28 and tau-3 after, the six-day pre-window width, and the P500 loser measurement (T-20261001-02).

claim: Hartzmark and Solomon, "Predictable Price Pressure" (NBER w30688, 2022): VW market returns rise with predictable aggregate dividend payments, about 8 bp/day in the top quintile of abnormal payment days against about 2 bp in the lowest two; investing in the top 2 weeks earns about 1.4% a year; effects survive day-of-week and turn-of-month controls.
quote: dividends is associated with value-weighted market returns of about 8 basis points
limitations: Index-level daily edge (about 8 bp on top-quintile days) is below one 20 bp round trip under the frozen 10 bp/side contract; needs payable dates for all US payers, which we do not hold.
independent_replication: International evidence in the paper itself; no independent trading replication opened.
impact_on_spec: Not a candidate. Recorded as not executable standalone; possible later conditioning variable for the dash-for-cash window only if that window survives.

claim: SEC final rule (press release 2023-29, 2023-02-15): standard settlement for most broker-dealer securities transactions shortened from T+2 to T+1; compliance date May 28, 2024.
quote: The compliance date for the final rules is May 28, 2024.
limitations: Verbatim sentences via WebFetch; sec.gov served a bot page to curl, so no full-page snapshot.
independent_replication: Nathan et al. 2026 use the same date.
impact_on_spec: Fixes the boundary switch date: b = tau-3 for months with tau >= 2024-05-28.

claim: Graziani (2024, SSRN job-market paper "Time Series Reversal: An End-of-the-Month Perspective"): the S&P 500 return from the fourth Friday to month end predicts next-month returns with a negative sign; basis of E0 in C2.
limitations: Snapshot taken by the 2026-09-28 round (h20260928_20); not re-read this round beyond the incumbent rule.
independent_replication: Harbourfront Quant newsletter summary; our own E0 screen (anchor 1.24, stress 0.58, 2026 -0.57).
impact_on_spec: Incumbent E0 that the replacement rule compares against.

claim: Harbourfront Quant newsletter summary of Graziani (2024): end-of-month S&P 500 returns from the fourth Friday reverse in the next month; practitioner restatement of the E0 rule.
limitations: Practitioner summary; snapshot from the 2026-09-28 round.

claim: Quantseeker practitioner test: after 2015 the [0,+3] turn-of-month window is not significant in US ETFs; the [-3,+3] window is still significant (5-12 bp/day higher) but has declined over the past decade.
limitations: Read through the WebFetch summarizer only; not load-bearing. Publication date not checked (placeholder 2025-01-01).
independent_replication: Consistent with our TOM_SPY refutation (close tau -> close tau+4: anchor -0.69, stress -0.10).
impact_on_spec: Sets the prior that only the pre-month-end part of the window can still pay.

claim: Hull Tactical (2024-05-17): buying SPY at the last trading day close and selling at the 4th trading day close captured 44% of total return while invested about 20% of days.
limitations: Harvest excerpt only (2026-09-23); the same rule (TOM_SPY) failed our frozen screen.
independent_replication: etftrends.com runs the same rule; our TOM_SPY screen contradicts it for 2016-2026.
impact_on_spec: Negative evidence: the classic post-month-end window is not the trade.
